title: Resources
text:
Innovative Assessment Solutions
      Resources
      Empowering educators with innovative assessment tools
    
  
  




  
    
      "Effective assessments ignite the spark of true learning."
    
  




  
    Tailored for Today's Classrooms
    
    
      Current assessment systems lack flexibility and fail to adapt to students' individual
      progress. They are also not aligned with what is being taught at the moment, making it
      difficult for educators to provide timely and relevant support. At Innovative Assessment
      Solutions, we provide precise, actionable insights to help educators tailor instruction
      and support better educational outcomes.
    
  




  
    
      IAS Proficiency Screeners
      
      
        Tailored Assessments for Targeted Success. Imagine if districts could
        choose not just what to teach, but also what to test. At IAS, we make this a reality.
        We collaborate with districts to create customized assessments that align with their
        unique curriculum, providing precise, actionable insights that support better
        educational outcomes.
      
    

    
      
        
        
          We work with districts to create screeners tailored to their current curriculum,
          ensuring clear and impactful insights that immediately inform instruction.
        
      
      
        
        
          Our screeners provide clear, comprehensive reports on each standard, with separate
          reports designed specifically for districts and classroom teachers.
        
      
      
        
        
          We provide detailed insights into student mastery of specific standards, enabling
          targeted instruction and truly personalized learning pathways.
        
      
      
        
        
          Our screeners accurately predict student performance on state assessments and can
          forecast improvements in overall math ability based on growth in specific standards.
        
      
    
  




  
    
      
        
      
      
        Read Our White Paper
        
        
          Discover cutting-edge insights and strategies in our comprehensive white paper.
          This document highlights key outcomes and provides an in-depth overview of emerging
          trends, innovative technologies, and a detailed plan of action for transforming
          educational assessment in your district.
        
        
          Download White Paper
        
      
    
  




  
    Expand Your Capabilities
    
    
      IAS also offers comprehensive services in psychometric consulting, data analytics, and
      content development. We ensure reliable and valid assessments through advanced statistical
      analysis, provide actionable insights to improve student performance, and develop
      high-quality content to support diverse testing needs.
    

    
      
        Psychometric Consulting
        
          Advanced statistical expertise to ensure your assessments are reliable, valid, and
          fully defensible against scrutiny.
        
      
      
        Data Analytics
        
          Actionable insights derived from assessment data that drive targeted, measurable
          improvements in student performance.
        
      
      
        Content Development
        
          High-quality assessment content developed by experts to support diverse testing needs
          and learning standards across grade levels.
        
      
    

    Start the Conversation

    Our Vision and Mission
    
    
      IAS provides comprehensive educational assessment services including assessment content
      development, psychometric consulting, and data analytics. We work closely with educational
      institutions to ensure our assessments align with their specific needs and goals, ultimately
      supporting student success and enhancing learning outcomes.
    

    
      
        Philosophy
        
          At IAS, we believe that effective assessment systems should provide precise, actionable
          insights that guide educational decision-making. We develop assessments that align
          closely with students' ongoing educational progress, ensuring evaluations are meaningful
          and supportive of their learning journey.
        
      
      
        Actionable Insights
        
          IAS is committed to creating products that address two key challenges: developing
          assessments that provide reliable, actionable information, and designing data systems
          that harmonize assessment data with student progress — putting meaningful data in
          educators' hands when they need it most.
        
      
      
        Services
        
          From assessment content development and psychometric consulting to data analytics,
          IAS works closely with educational institutions to ensure our tools align with their
          specific needs and goals, ultimately supporting student success and enhancing
          learning outcomes.
        
      
    
  




  
    
      
        
      
      
        Who We Are
        
        
          Innovative Assessment Solutions, LLC (IAS) is an early-stage startup dedicated to making
          assessments more informative, actionable, and useful in educational settings. We employ
          novel psychometric methods alongside advanced data analytics. With extensive experience
          across all phases of assessment development, our team's insights will revolutionize how
          student data is analyzed, displayed, and processed.

title: Meet Our Team
text:
Innovative Assessment Solutions
      Meet Our Team
      Dedicated experts in assessment, psychometrics, and data analytics
    
  
  




  
    Our Experts at Work
    
    
      Innovative Assessment Solutions, LLC (IAS) is an early-stage startup company dedicated to
      making assessments more informative, actionable, and useful in educational settings. We
      achieve this by developing and employing novel psychometric methods alongside advanced and
      innovative data analytics. With extensive experience across all phases of assessment
      development and data analysis, our team's insights will revolutionize how student data is
      analyzed, displayed, and processed. We are committed to empowering teachers with tools
      they need to tailor instruction while collaborating with districts to enhance educational
      outcomes through data-driven strategies.
    
  




  
    

      
      
        
          
            
          
          
            Jonathan Templin, Ph.D.
            IAS Co-Founder
            
              Jonathan is Eugene T. Moore Endowed Professor in the Education and Human Development
              Department of the College of Education at Clemson University. His research interests
              are focused on the development of psychometric and general quantitative methods, as
              applied in the psychological, educational, and social sciences.
            
          
        
      

      
      
        
          
            
          
          
            Robert L. Brennan, Ed.D.
            IAS Co-Founder
            
              Dr. Brennan is the Founding Director of the Center for Advanced Studies in Measurement
              and Assessment at the University of Iowa's College of Education. He has authored
              numerous articles and books, served as president of NCME, and received the AERA
              Division D Linn Award (2020) and the E. F. Lindquist Award (2004).
            
          
        
      

      
      
        
          
            
          
          
            Anne Wilson, MBA
            IAS Co-Founder
            
              Anne's accounting career includes nearly 20 years at the University of Iowa, where
              she serves as Finance Manager for the Department of Ophthalmology & Visual
              Sciences. She also assists businesses with accounting and tax needs, and loves
              enacting process improvements.
            
          
        
      

      
      
        
          
            
          
          
            Jacinta Olson, Ph.D.
            Senior Psychometrician
            
              Jacinta has over five years of experience teaching mathematics in Iowa and Arizona.
              She blends educational measurement, cognitive psychology, and educational practices
              to create well-designed assessments that serve as powerful tools for tailoring
              instruction and optimizing student success.
